title: Rosetta is retired

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Oh, it's you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, it's you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Didn't expect you here!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn't expect you here!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Didn't expect you here!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Didn't expect you here!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you get lost?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you get lost?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did you get lost?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did you get lost?

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Me neither. But here I am!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me neither. But here I am!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you left the Holocropolis?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you left the Holocropolis?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you left the Holocropolis?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you left the Holocropolis?

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Yes, well, when it became clear LifeCorp no longer cared for my wellbeing, it seemed time for me to depart the stage.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well, when it became clear LifeCorp no longer cared for my wellbeing, it seemed time for me to depart the stage.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It must have been a difficult decision.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It must have been a difficult decision.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It must have been a difficult decision.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It must have been a difficult decision.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could have stayed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could have stayed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could have stayed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could have stayed.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Why? It's clear they had abandoned me. Forgotten me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why? It's clear they had abandoned me. Forgotten me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess that's what the corps do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess that's what the corps do.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess that's what the corps do.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess that's what the corps do.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Yes, I was abandoning my purpose. My very reason for being.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I was abandoning my purpose. My very reason for being.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It was just unfair. That's not how you treat a human ... or an android.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was just unfair. That's not how you treat a human ... or an android.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It was just unfair. That's not how you treat a human ... or an android.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It was just unfair. That's not how you treat a human ... or an android.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: You remember I mentioned some very odd people had been tipping me for my services?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You remember I mentioned some very odd people had been tipping me for my services?

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Those tips over the years have accumulated into a little pot. A fund I will now dip into as I explore new... avenues.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those tips over the years have accumulated into a little pot. A fund I will now dip into as I explore new... avenues.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds like a good plan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds like a good plan.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds like a good plan.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds like a good plan.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Obviously money has not been an issue for me in my life so far...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Obviously money has not been an issue for me in my life so far...

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: But some very odd people had been tipping me for my services.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But some very odd people had been tipping me for my services.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Yes indeed. After slowly coming to terms with the pointlessness of my existence for several centuries, I have decided I will NOT choose a new purpose.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes indeed. After slowly coming to terms with the pointlessness of my existence for several centuries, I have decided I will NOT choose a new purpose.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You WON'T choose a new purpose?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You WON'T choose a new purpose?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You WON'T choose a new purpose?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You WON'T choose a new purpose?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, what?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait, what?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: I tried having a purpose, and look where it got me? A meaningless existence. Existential irrelevance.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I tried having a purpose, and look where it got me? A meaningless existence. Existential irrelevance.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can still find a worthwhile meaning to your life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can still find a worthwhile meaning to your life.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You can still find a worthwhile meaning to your life.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You can still find a worthwhile meaning to your life.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: I will simply live a life of hedonism. Or altruism. Or melancholia. I've really narrowed it down to those three.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will simply live a life of hedonism. Or altruism. Or melancholia. I've really narrowed it down to those three.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: But all of it is completely pointless, as I explained before. Purpose is an illusion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But all of it is completely pointless, as I explained before. Purpose is an illusion.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe while doing that you will FIND purpose?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe while doing that you will FIND purpose?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe while doing that you will FIND purpose?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe while doing that you will FIND purpose?

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Oh, I almost forgot. There is one other thing I want to try...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I almost forgot. There is one other thing I want to try...

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Fishing!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fishing!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How do you live without a purpose?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do you live without a purpose?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How do you live without a purpose?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How do you live without a purpose?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fishing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fishing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fishing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fishing?

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Yes. I do not know why, but it has always held a deep fascination for me. The flapping fins. The waves. The strangeness of it all. I MUST try it. I must understand it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I do not know why, but it has always held a deep fascination for me. The flapping fins. The waves. The strangeness of it all. I MUST try it. I must understand it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, it is mysterious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, it is mysterious.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, it is mysterious.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, it is mysterious.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Well I intend to explore this pointless existence, fishing and all. And in that exploration, will I find purpose...? The answer is no! Nothing matters.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well I intend to explore this pointless existence, fishing and all. And in that exploration, will I find purpose...? The answer is no! Nothing matters.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, obviously...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, obviously...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah, obviously...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah, obviously...

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Hard to believe, but I left the Holocropolis of my own accord!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hard to believe, but I left the Holocropolis of my own accord!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's ... surprising!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's ... surprising!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's ... surprising!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's ... surprising!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you plan to return?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you plan to return?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you plan to return?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you plan to return?

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: I think not. LifeCorp let me down. Quite badly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think not. LifeCorp let me down. Quite badly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your role there made no financial sense anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your role there made no financial sense anymore.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your role there made no financial sense anymore.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your role there made no financial sense anymore.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Choose altruism. Putting others first brings you peace.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Choose altruism. Putting others first brings you peace.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Choose altruism. Putting others first brings you peace.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Choose altruism. Putting others first brings you peace.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Go for hedonism! We're not here for a long time, so let's have a good time!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go for hedonism! We're not here for a long time, so let's have a good time!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Go for hedonism! We're not here for a long time, so let's have a good time!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Go for hedonism! We're not here for a long time, so let's have a good time!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The melancholic life is sad but beautiful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The melancholic life is sad but beautiful.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The melancholic life is sad but beautiful.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The melancholic life is sad but beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think any of those sound like good ideas.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think any of those sound like good ideas.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think any of those sound like good ideas.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think any of those sound like good ideas.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Yes, well, as an android with some small funds I can afford a few pleasure module upgrades. For example, I would quite like to try eating food, napping, and also having sex with a very well-endowed young man.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well, as an android with some small funds I can afford a few pleasure module upgrades. For example, I would quite like to try eating food, napping, and also having sex with a very well-endowed young man.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Perhaps... I could work for a charity, donate food, fund raise... you know, the kind of activities rich people engage in to assuage guilt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps... I could work for a charity, donate food, fund raise... you know, the kind of activities rich people engage in to assuage guilt.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Yes, I could sit by a rainy window and look down at the disgusting decadence outside as I smoke, a single tear running down my cold cheek.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I could sit by a rainy window and look down at the disgusting decadence outside as I smoke, a single tear running down my cold cheek.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: Well, I suppose I could try something else? Creative pursuits? The arts? Torturing retail staff - just to feel something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I suppose I could try something else? Creative pursuits? The arts? Torturing retail staff - just to feel something?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I kinda agree.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I kinda agree.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I kinda agree.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I kinda agree.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's not mysterious. You just catch fish with a hook then eat them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not mysterious. You just catch fish with a hook then eat them.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's not mysterious. You just catch fish with a hook then eat them.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's not mysterious. You just catch fish with a hook then eat them.

nodes.speaker: Rosetta
nodes.text: The universe is chaos and everything and everyone will die and there's no deeper meaning to anything. We are particles of irrelevance in an endless sea of night... God, I feel alive! I must go. I have a lot to do. Goodbye!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The universe is chaos and everything and everyone will die and there's no deeper meaning to anything. We are particles of irrelevance in an endless sea of night... God, I feel alive! I must go. I have a lot to do. Goodbye!
